confidence_notes: Meal, coffee and beer estimates use [aggregated local prices](https://www.averagecostof.living/in/romania/cluj-napoca/restaurants/). The cocktail estimate is informed by a [local nightlife guide](https://stealmyguide.com/cluj-napoca/nightlife-guide/); wine is estimated relative to beer and checked against one [local menu](https://how-hotel.ro/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Meniu-bauturi-Kohe-Panineria-Caffe-Euphoria-Cafenea-Cluj.pdf). Accommodation is a holistic estimate, with substantial uncertainty around July event dates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Cluj-Napoca data. Accommodation estimates reflect its role as a Romanian university and business city and the wider regional market.
